We invite you to join our discord channel to give us many more ideas
The next update will be a new DLC for halloween

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 02
notes.content:
New feature: buttons added to change color, contrast, etc. The effect is applied when the button is unpressed.

Import bug fixed: When importing an emote, the layers remained empty. It is now fixed but previous exports will no longer work (bug that only appeared in French)
